title: PlastiCrete AI
summary: An explainable machine learning platform predicting mechanical and physical properties of plastic-waste composite construction materials from mix design inputs, replacing costly lab tests with fast inference. Its M1 prediction module optionally uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, imported via sdv.single_table, to augment the training dataset with synthetic rows.
evidence: trainer.py:192-215 `from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer` ... `synth = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=epochs, ...); synth.fit(train_data); synth.sample(...)`
